correctness.rationale: For unit graph-metric path P4 with symmetric edge conductances a,b,c>0, DQ=BD with B=[[-2a,b,0],[a,-2b,c],[0,b,-2c]], so sharp Lipschitz norm is max row sum of exp(tB), attained only by affine ramps for t>0 as exp(tB)>0. In cone b>2a>0,c>3(b-a), u1>u3 by positive variation of constants. g=u2-u1 has zero at t=0, positive initial derivative c-3(b-a), negative eventual sign by Perron vector with v1>v2, and is 3-real-exponential; Rolle zero-count gives exactly one positive simple switch. For (1,3,9), exact rational Taylor degree 26 with epsilon<10^-20 brackets switch in (5285/100000,5286/100000) and certifies u2’(switch)<0. Unique extrema of u2 and u1 follow zero count and sign; two local maxima with cusp min. For P3, difference of two real exponentials with zero at 0 cannot switch at positive t. Independent exact rational matrix and interval computations corroborated. No extension to every cone parameter for two-peak count.
